seed.home.title: SIMAI page editor
seed.home.lead: This page is a SIMAI Framework Composition Document, drawn by SF.Composition.render.
seed.home.layoutText: Choose a block on the canvas: sf-composition-overlay draws the frame, the toolbar above the block and the insertion places.
seed.home.contentText: The Page content block below is where the layout puts the page’s text. Double click it or press Enter to type; Esc twice brings the layout back.
seed.about.title: About
seed.about.text: The second page shows that the page list is kept in the browser and switches the document on the canvas.
seed.starter.heading: A new heading
seed.home.p1: This text is the page’s content document. The same SF.Composition.render draws it, and sf-content-editor from SIMAI Pro types in it.
seed.home.li1: Press Enter at the end of a line for a new paragraph.
seed.home.li2: Type “## ” in an empty line to make it a heading.
seed.home.li3: Type “/” in an empty line for the list of block kinds.
seed.home.p2: Select a word: a bar over it gives bold, italic, code and link.
